messages:
tara: quick heads-up — canarying osmium14b int4. hitting sporadic OOMs on long summaries (>600). logs below.
noah: can you share the canary config?
tara: microbatch=1, batch=4, prefetch_window=128, max_new_tokens=1024. artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/osmium14b/int4/canary-2026-03-25
su: paste from worker: ```RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory while allocating 1.1 GiB
slot_allocator: failed to reserve contiguous block 512MB
Timeline: prefetch->kv_load->decode```
ben: that pattern looks like slab fragmentation due to prefetch + large allocation. try prefetch_window=32 + prefetch_padding=32 and lower max_new_tokens to 512 for canary.
tara: testing now with `--prefetch_window 32 --prefetch_padding 32 --max_new_tokens 512`
deploy-bot: :rocket: canary deploy started for osmium14b-int4 -> pool-canary-1
tara: update: 500 requests with new settings => p95 down, 0 OOMs, ROUGE-L delta -2.5 vs fp16.
noah: good sign. proposal: set conservative defaults for new int4 variants: max_new_tokens=512, prefetch_window<=48, default prefetch_padding=32. also add a runtime retry that attempts a kv-compact for 150ms on allocation failure.
su: agree. quant layouts make contiguous allocation brittle. need both config defaults and a compact fallback.
ben: I'll prototype kv-compact-on-failure. will bench perf hit. if okay, gate behind feature flag.
tara: filing ticket ML-1510: "osmium14b int4 canary: conservative defaults + kv-compact experiment". next: run full summarization+longform sweep. will post results. :thumbsup:
